# Ksav Hebrew lexicon — words this product writes itself. Generated by
# `cargo run --example emit-product-words` from the interface strings, the two
# starter documents and the twelve templates. Do not edit by hand: add the word
# where it is written, then rerun.
#
# The list is the checker's own tokenizer run over those sources against an empty
# dictionary, so it holds exactly the tokens the checker will look up — including
# `ב"ה` and `מהרש"א`, which a hand-written splitter turns into fragments.
#
# This layer is **always on**, whatever the writer chooses for the modern and
# rabbinic halves: the product may not underline its own vocabulary. Words the
# corpus layers already hold are repeated here on purpose — a product word must
# not depend on a setting somebody else chose.
#
# 2709 entries, no bands (nothing here is a corpus frequency).
